```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explode AS (
    SELECT
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS qty_per_unit,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explode be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.qty_per_unit * be.order_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explode be
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'PD-R853';
```

WITH RECURSIVE 
relevant_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date,
        p.product_number AS sold_code
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
),
distinct_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sold_code AS root_code, order_date
    FROM relevant_orders
),
bom AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.root_code,
        dp.order_date,
        dp.root_code AS comp_code,
        1.0 AS qty,
        0 AS depth
    FROM distinct_pairs dp
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        b.root_code,
        b.order_date,
        c.child_code,
        b.qty * c.qty,
        b.depth + 1
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = b.comp_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = b.comp_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND c.valid_from <= b.order_date 
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR b.order_date <= c.valid_to)
      AND b.depth < 20
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(ro.order_qty * b.qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM relevant_orders ro
JOIN bom b ON b.root_code = ro.sold_code AND b.order_date = ro.order_date
WHERE b.comp_code = 'PD-R853'

WITH RECURSIVE
bike_products(product_id) AS (
    SELECT p.product_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON ps.subcategory_id = p.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON pc.category_id = ps.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
bom_edges(assembly_id, component_id) AS (
    SELECT b.assembly_id, b.component_id
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.component_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
bom_tree(root_product_id, component_id) AS (
    SELECT bp.product_id, e.component_id
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN bom_edges e ON e.assembly_id = bp.product_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bt.root_product_id, e.component_id
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bom_edges e ON e.assembly_id = bt.component_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bt.root_product_id) AS bike_count
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product c ON c.product_id = bt.component_id
WHERE c.product_number = 'TI-M823';

      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= c.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_code) AS bike_count
